identification: Louis Vuitton black Taiga (grained) leather six-ring (3+3) binder cover, near-square, LV embossed lower right on front, gilt rings, brown LV flower-embossed divider card, blank cream pages with LV flower blind stamps along the bottom, in tan LV 'Malletier a Paris, Maison fondee en 1854' box. Best match on shape and ring layout is the LV Taiga Desk Agenda cover (Agenda de Bureau, R20409 black / R20407 Epicea) fitted with blank drawing-paper refill, which is presumably why it is catalogued as a sketch book. Not confirmed: no model code, date code or heat stamp readable in the 800x600 photos. Authenticity not verifiable from photos; estimate A$20-40 suggests the house has not checked it either.

viewing_check: Heat stamp inside the cover ('Louis Vuitton Paris made in France') and a date code (two letters + four digits) in a pocket or under the ring plate. Model number on box or tag (R20409 / R20407 means desk agenda). Measure it (desk agenda cover is about 27 x 22 cm). Ring plate stamped LV, stitching even, leather smell. Photograph the date code and box underside.
